integrity: The analytic argument covers all admissible positive spectral gaps and angles; supplementary finite tests are not substitutes for a proof. No independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The sharp constants concern Hermitian 2×2 pairs and normalized scalar traces; the commutator quotient requires noncommutation. The tensor extension is slice-wise, not an unrestricted all-dimension inequality. Publication priority may depend on older matrix-inequality literature not fully accessible.
title: Sharp spectral-gap commutator stability for the two-dimensional Golden–Thompson defect
